svg.title: Level sets of x^T A x: ellipses for the definite matrix, hyperbolas for the saddle

text.tspan: Level sets tell definiteness at a glance
Blue: f = c > 0 (c = 1, 2, 4 on the bowl; c = 1, 2 on the saddle). Amber: f = −1, −2.
